newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Senegal seeks private sector help in water sector.
newsitem.headline: Senegal seeks private sector help in water sector.

text.p: The International Finance Corporation (IFC) said it had agreed to help Senegal find a private sector operator to improve the supply of water to the capital, Dakar.
The IFC, the unit of the World Bank that promotes private sector projects, said drinking water supply fell substantially short of demand in Dakar and the situation was getting worse.

The government was already implementing structural reforms in the sector, and was turning to private investors for help on transporting water to Dakar from the Senegal River basin, 240 km (150 miles) to the north, it said.
